data.description: A Great Old One's aura inflicts intense mental anguish and torment upon all creatures within 300 feet who can see and hear the Great Old One. The exact effects caused by a Great Old One's unspeakable presence vary by type. A successful Will save (DC %1) reduces or negates the effect. This is a mind-affecting effect.
data.name: Unspeakable Presence
